summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that the second $400-a-side deposit for the Allen-McCoole fight was made at Tom Kelley's saloon. The fight was set for September 23; Allen, at 200 pounds, was walking to reach 170.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Democrat, Wednesday, June 11, 1873 (Daily Democrat).

facts.fact: The second deposit of $400 a side for the Allen-McCoole fight was made at Tom Kelley's saloon; three more deposits of $500 each were due in July, August and September
places: Tom Kelley's saloon, Sixth near Market, St. Louis

facts.fact: The Allen-McCoole fight was scheduled for September 23, 1873
Allen weighed about 200 pounds and was training at home by walking to reach a fighting weight of 170 pounds
